about_the_game:
The "Okko The Exiled Demo" gives players an early look at the first chapter of Okko's journey! 

Make your way to The Old Throne and then hunt down the Old Sabaoth Guardian at the Mount of the Dead!

Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the Demon Lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

After 1,000 years of concealment, Okko is ready to wield the Mighty Fang and take down Kutala’s lords one by one. Defeat powerful foes, overcome obstacles, and unleash your heart as Okko fights to fulfill an ancient oath.
